Keep honoring that ritual. It’s not " taking time"— it’s *giving* time to yourself, and that’s one of the most meaningful things you can do. 💖 *(And if you ever want to swap tips on products, techniques, or how to make the ritual even more enjoyable— I’m here for it!)* 😊
